olders.part: Decision §1, the second bullet ("The work layer is tracker issues labelled `work-item`: Epic, Story, Spike, Chore and Bug") — an Epic is now an issue of type Epic and a Story an issue of type Story, each with no label; only a Spike, a Chore or a Bug keeps `work-item`. And Consequences, Positive, the fourth bullet ("`work-item` for everything that is worked") — `work-item` now marks only a Spike, a Chore or a Bug.
